benefits_summary: Income support of ₹6,000 per year to eligible farmer families, paid in three equal instalments of ₹2,000, subject to current Government of India rules.
benefits_unverified_note: Instalment release dates and any special packages change. Confirm the latest instalment status on the official PM-KISAN portal.

exclusions: Farmer families in which one or more members paid income tax in the last assessment year (as per scheme guidelines)
Serving or retired officers/employees of government/PSUs above specified grades, and other notified exclusion categories
eligibility.notes: Eligibility is determined from land records and exclusion lists published by the Government of India and the State Nodal Officer. Tenancy rules vary by state.

required_documents.name: Aadhaar
required_documents.why: Used for identity and DBT authentication on the official portal.

required_documents.name: Land ownership record (7/12 extract / Record of Rights)
required_documents.why: PM-KISAN is linked to cultivable land records.

required_documents.name: Bank passbook / cancelled cheque (account details)
required_documents.why: Benefit is transferred to a bank account linked for DBT. Enter details only on the official portal, never in this app.

required_documents.name: Passport-size photograph
required_documents.why: May be requested during CSC or state registration.

application_method: Online on PM-KISAN portal, through a Common Service Centre (CSC), or via the State Nodal Officer / village revenue office.

application_steps.title: Check eligibility
application_steps.detail: Confirm you are a farmer family with cultivable land in records and that you are not in a notified exclusion category.

application_steps.title: Gather documents
application_steps.detail: Keep Aadhaar, land record, and bank passbook ready. Do not share OTP or banking password with anyone, including this app.

application_steps.title: Open the official portal
application_steps.detail: Use https://pmkisan.gov.in only. Beware of lookalike websites.

application_steps.title: Register or sign in on the government site
application_steps.detail: New farmers typically use Farmer Corner / new registration. Existing beneficiaries can check status with Aadhaar. Authentication happens on the government website, not here.

application_steps.title: Locate the registration or correction form
application_steps.detail: Follow Farmer Corner links on the official site. Menu labels can change; use the portal help / FAQ if unsure.

application_steps.title: Enter farmer and land details
application_steps.detail: Fill name, Aadhaar, bank, and land details exactly as in official records.

application_steps.title: Upload documents if asked
application_steps.detail: Upload only on the official site or at an authorised CSC.

application_steps.title: Review and submit
application_steps.detail: Check every field before submit. State/district officials verify records.

application_steps.title: Save acknowledgement
application_steps.detail: Note the registration/acknowledgement number shown by the portal.

application_steps.title: Check status
application_steps.detail: Use Beneficiary Status on pmkisan.gov.in. Follow up with the State Nodal Officer if payment is pending after verification.

deadline_note: No single national application deadline. Instalments follow Government of India release calendar.
source_notes: Facts taken from the official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in). Final eligibility is decided by the government, not this app.

department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
benefits_summary: Crop insurance cover against notified yield losses, prevented sowing, mid-season adversity, and post-harvest losses where the state has notified the crop, area, and season. Sum insured and premium subsidy follow the current season notification.
benefits_unverified_note: Notified crops, areas, premium, and cut-off dates change every season. This app cannot confirm that a crop is notified in your village for the current season.

eligibility.notes: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas can apply, subject to state operational guidelines and enrolment cut-off dates.

required_documents.name: Aadhaar
required_documents.why: Used for farmer identification on the National Crop Insurance Portal.

required_documents.name: Land record or tenancy/sharecropping proof accepted by the state
required_documents.why: Enrolment is linked to notified survey numbers / land or tenancy evidence.

required_documents.name: Bank account details
required_documents.why: Claims are paid by DBT. Provide details only on the official portal or to an authorised bank/CSC.

required_documents.name: Sowing / crop details
required_documents.why: Required to enrol the correct notified crop and area.

required_documents.name: Kisan Credit Card details
required_documents.why: Relevant if you enrol through a bank linked to KCC; loanee enrolment rules follow the current season policy.

application_method: National Crop Insurance Portal, authorised banks, CSCs, or insurance intermediaries listed on the official site.

application_steps.title: Check whether your crop and village are notified
application_steps.detail: Open pmfby.gov.in and check the current season notification for your state, district, crop, and cut-off date.

application_steps.title: Gather land/tenancy and identity documents
application_steps.detail: Do not miss the seasonal cut-off. Late applications are usually rejected.

application_steps.title: Open the official NCIP / PMFBY website
application_steps.detail: Use https://pmfby.gov.in or the National Crop Insurance Portal linked from that site.

application_steps.title: Sign in on the government portal
application_steps.detail: Create or use a farmer login on the official portal. Never type the portal password or OTP into AI-KrushiMitra.

application_steps.title: Find farmer enrolment
application_steps.detail: Use the farmer application / enrolment section for the current season. Labels change; follow on-portal help.

application_steps.title: Enter crop, survey, and bank details
application_steps.detail: Select the notified crop and area exactly as in the notification.

application_steps.title: Upload documents
application_steps.detail: Upload land/tenancy and identity documents if the portal asks.

application_steps.title: Pay farmer share of premium if required
application_steps.detail: Pay only through official portal/bank channels. Premium rates are season-specific.

application_steps.title: Save policy / application number
application_steps.detail: Download or note the acknowledgement and policy details.

application_steps.title: Track claims
application_steps.detail: Use the portal application status / claim status. Yield-based claims follow crop-cutting experiments; this app cannot compute claim amounts.

deadline_note: Seasonal cut-off dates are notified by each state for Kharif/Rabi. Check the portal for the current season.
source_notes: Official portal pmfby.gov.in. Enrolment is not automatic and is not guaranteed by this matcher.

department: Department of Financial Services / NABARD / Scheduled Banks
benefits_summary: Short-term credit for cultivation, post-harvest, and farm-related needs through banks, with interest subvention as notified by the Government of India from time to time. Exact limit and interest rate are decided by the lending bank.
benefits_unverified_note: Interest subvention percentages and repayment terms are notified periodically. Confirm current rates with a scheduled bank or NABARD circulars.

eligibility.notes: Farmers, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers, and eligible SHGs/JLGs as per RBI/NABARD KCC guidelines may apply. Bank due diligence applies.

required_documents.name: Aadhaar or other KYC identity proof accepted by the bank
required_documents.why: Banks must complete KYC.

required_documents.name: Land record or tenancy evidence accepted by the bank
required_documents.why: Used to assess scale of finance.

required_documents.name: Photographs
required_documents.why: Bank account / card issuance KYC.

required_documents.name: Existing bank account details if any
required_documents.why: May speed up processing at your bank.

application_method: Apply at a scheduled commercial bank, RRBs, or cooperative bank branch, or through Jan Samarth / bank digital channels where offered.

application_steps.title: Confirm you need crop credit
application_steps.detail: KCC is a bank product, not an automatic government grant.

application_steps.title: Collect KYC and land/tenancy papers
application_steps.detail: Banks publish their own checklist. This app cannot replace the bank form.

application_steps.title: Use official channels
application_steps.detail: Visit your bank, or use https://www.jansamarth.in if your bank offers KCC there. Also see https://www.nabard.org for scheme background.

application_steps.title: Sign in only on the bank/Jan Samarth site
application_steps.detail: Never enter net-banking password or OTP in AI-KrushiMitra.

application_steps.title: Locate the KCC application
application_steps.detail: Ask the branch agricultural officer or use the bank's KCC / agri-loan section. Menu names differ by bank.

application_steps.title: Fill crop, land, and scale-of-finance details
application_steps.detail: The bank calculates the credit limit.

application_steps.title: Submit KYC documents to the bank
application_steps.detail: Upload only on the bank portal or submit physical copies at the branch.

application_steps.title: Review sanction terms
application_steps.detail: Read interest, charges, and repayment before accepting.

application_steps.title: Keep sanction letter / account number
application_steps.detail: Store bank acknowledgement safely.

application_steps.title: Follow up with the same bank
application_steps.detail: Status is with the lending bank, not this app.

deadline_note: Banks accept applications throughout the year; processing is bank-specific.
source_notes: NABARD and Jan Samarth are official references. Individual bank circulars govern sanction.

department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / Department of Water Resources (component-wise)
benefits_summary: Support for irrigation, including 'Per Drop More Crop' micro-irrigation (drip/sprinkler) and other PMKSY components implemented by states. Subsidy rates and unit costs are notified by the state implementing agency.
benefits_unverified_note: Component-wise subsidy percentages and eligible equipment lists vary by state and financial year.

eligibility.notes: Farmers with irrigable land applying for notified micro-irrigation systems. Water source and spacing norms apply. Tenant eligibility depends on state rules.

required_documents.name: Aadhaar
required_documents.why: DBT and farmer identification.

required_documents.name: 7/12 extract / land possession proof
required_documents.why: Area proposed for micro-irrigation must match land records.

required_documents.name: Proof of water source (well/borewell/canal permission as applicable)
required_documents.why: Micro-irrigation requires a reliable water source as per state guidelines.

required_documents.name: Bank account details
required_documents.why: Subsidy is credited after installation and inspection.

required_documents.name: Photographs
required_documents.why: Often required with the state application.

application_method: State agriculture / horticulture department or MahaDBT (Maharashtra) / other state portals; PMKSY national pages for guidelines.

application_steps.title: Check the component you need
application_steps.detail: Per Drop More Crop is the usual farmer-facing micro-irrigation component. Other PMKSY components are often taken up by departments/projects.

application_steps.title: Confirm state implementation
application_steps.detail: Maharashtra farmers typically apply through MahaDBT agriculture services, not a single national farmer form.

application_steps.title: Open official sites
application_steps.detail: Guidelines: https://pmksy.gov.in . Maharashtra applications: https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in

application_steps.title: Register on the state portal
application_steps.detail: Authenticate only on the government portal.

application_steps.title: Find micro-irrigation / PDMC service
application_steps.detail: Service names on MahaDBT can change. Use the agriculture department list.

application_steps.title: Enter land, crop, and irrigation system
application_steps.detail: Choose drip or sprinkler as per crop and department list.

application_steps.title: Upload land and water-source documents
application_steps.detail: Follow the state checklist.

application_steps.title: Submit and await technical sanction
application_steps.detail: Work often proceeds through empaneled suppliers after approval.

application_steps.title: Save application ID
application_steps.detail: Keep the MahaDBT/state acknowledgement.

application_steps.title: Inspection and subsidy
application_steps.detail: Subsidy follows field inspection. Track status on the same state portal.

deadline_note: State windows and budget availability apply. Check MahaDBT or your state department.
source_notes: National guidelines from pmksy.gov.in; state delivery via MahaDBT or equivalent.

department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / State Agriculture Departments
benefits_summary: Soil sample testing and a Soil Health Card with nutrient status and fertilizer recommendations. It is an advisory service, not a cash transfer.
benefits_unverified_note: Sampling cycles and lab turnaround are run by states. Card availability should be checked on the Soil Health Card portal.

eligibility.notes: Farmers with agricultural land in the sampling grid / who request testing through the state agriculture department.

required_documents.name: Aadhaar or farmer identity used by the state
required_documents.why: Needed if you register on the portal or at a Raithu/Krishi office.

required_documents.name: Land details / survey number
required_documents.why: Sample is linked to a plot.

application_method: Soil Health Card portal and state agriculture / soil testing labs.

application_steps.title: See if a card already exists
application_steps.detail: Search on https://www.soilhealth.dac.gov.in using the options published on the portal.

application_steps.title: Contact local agriculture office if no recent card
application_steps.detail: Village sampling is usually scheduled by the department.

application_steps.title: Use only the official soil health portal
application_steps.detail: https://www.soilhealth.dac.gov.in

application_steps.title: Do not share OTPs here
application_steps.detail: Any login is on the government site only.

application_steps.title: Locate farmer search / print card
application_steps.detail: Portal menus change; use Help on the site.

application_steps.title: Provide survey number and farmer details if registering a sample
application_steps.detail: Follow lab instructions for sampling depth and bags.

application_steps.title: No document upload is required in this app
application_steps.detail: Physical soil sample is submitted to the designated lab.

application_steps.title: Wait for lab results
application_steps.detail: Recommendations appear on the card after testing.

application_steps.title: Download or collect the card
application_steps.detail: Print from the portal if available.

application_steps.title: Follow fertilizer advice with local extension
application_steps.detail: The card is advisory. Confirm doses with a local officer for your crop.

deadline_note: Sampling is periodic, not a farmer lottery with a single deadline.
source_notes: Official Soil Health Card portal of DAC&FW.

official_name: PM-KUSUM (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan)
department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
benefits_summary: Support for solar agriculture pumps and solarisation of existing grid-connected pumps, implemented by states. Component-wise CFA and farmer contribution are notified by MNRE and the state implementing agency.
benefits_unverified_note: Open components, pump capacity limits, and subsidy shares change. Confirm current Component A/B/C availability in your state.

eligibility.notes: Typically individual farmers / groups with agricultural land and (for pumps) water source. DISCOM/state agency terms apply.

required_documents.name: Aadhaar
required_documents.why: Farmer identity.

required_documents.name: Land ownership record
required_documents.why: Installation is on agricultural land / pump site.

required_documents.name: Electricity connection / pump details
required_documents.why: Required for solarisation of existing pumps (Component C).

required_documents.name: Bank account
required_documents.why: Subsidy / payment processing by the state agency.

application_method: State implementing agency / DISCOM portal; MNRE scheme page for guidelines.

application_steps.title: Check if your state is inviting applications
application_steps.detail: PM-KUSUM is demand-driven and state-implemented.

application_steps.title: Read current component rules
application_steps.detail: Standalone solar pump vs solarisation have different documents.

application_steps.title: Open MNRE scheme information
application_steps.detail: https://mnre.gov.in and the PM-KUSUM pages linked from MNRE. Maharashtra may also list the service on MahaDBT.

application_steps.title: Apply only on the state/DISCOM portal
application_steps.detail: Never share portal OTP with this app.

application_steps.title: Find PM-KUSUM / solar pump service
application_steps.detail: Names vary by DISCOM.

application_steps.title: Enter pump capacity and land details
application_steps.detail: Follow the notified capacity bands.

application_steps.title: Upload land and connection documents
application_steps.detail: Only on the official portal.

application_steps.title: Submit for technical feasibility
application_steps.detail: DISCOM/agency inspection may be required.

application_steps.title: Save application number
application_steps.detail: Keep the acknowledgement.

application_steps.title: Track vendor installation
application_steps.detail: Work is done by empaneled vendors after sanction.

source_notes: MNRE is the nodal ministry. State portals handle applications.

official_name: MahaDBT — Agriculture, Dairy Development, Animal Husbandry and Fisheries Services
department: Government of Maharashtra / Direct Benefit Transfer portal
benefits_summary: Single Maharashtra portal for many farmer-facing DBT schemes (farm mechanisation, micro-irrigation, horticulture, etc.). Each service has its own eligibility, documents, and opening dates.
benefits_unverified_note: Individual MahaDBT services open and close independently. This matcher cannot list every live service without the current portal catalogue.

eligibility.notes: Must be a Maharashtra resident farmer (or other notified beneficiary type) as required by the specific service. Aadhaar-based MahaDBT profile is typically required.

required_documents.name: Aadhaar
required_documents.why: MahaDBT uses Aadhaar authentication.

required_documents.name: Maharashtra residence proof if asked
required_documents.why: State schemes are jurisdiction-limited.

required_documents.name: 7/12 extract and 8A where the service needs land
required_documents.why: Most agriculture subsidies need land records; some livestock services may not.

required_documents.name: Bank account linked for DBT
required_documents.why: Subsidy is paid by DBT. Enter bank details only on MahaDBT.

required_documents.name: Caste / income certificate
required_documents.why: Required only when a specific service is reserved or income-capped.

application_method: https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in — Farmer registration then apply to an open service.

application_steps.title: Confirm you live/farm in Maharashtra
application_steps.detail: MahaDBT agriculture services are state schemes.

application_steps.title: Keep Aadhaar and 7/12 ready
application_steps.detail: Do not upload scans into AI-KrushiMitra.

application_steps.title: Open MahaDBT
application_steps.detail: https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in

application_steps.title: Register / authenticate on MahaDBT
application_steps.detail: Use Aadhaar OTP only on the government site.

application_steps.title: Open Farmer / Agriculture department services
application_steps.detail: Browse currently open schemes. Availability changes.

application_steps.title: Read that scheme's guidelines PDF on the portal
application_steps.detail: Do not rely on unofficial blogs for document lists.

application_steps.title: Fill and upload on MahaDBT only
application_steps.detail: Follow the service-specific form.

application_steps.title: Submit while the service is open
application_steps.detail: Closed services will not accept forms.

application_steps.title: Save the MahaDBT application ID
application_steps.detail: Screenshot or download acknowledgement.

application_steps.title: Track under My Applications
application_steps.detail: Department officers verify. This app cannot show live MahaDBT status.

deadline_note: Each listed service has its own opening and closing dates on MahaDBT.
source_notes: Official Maharashtra DBT portal. Treat individual scheme benefits as unverified until you open that service's guideline on MahaDBT.

official_name: Magel Tyala Shettale (Farm Pond) and related water conservation works (Maharashtra)
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra
benefits_summary: Maharashtra farm-pond / farm-water storage assistance as implemented through the Agriculture Department and MahaDBT when the service is open. Dimensions, lining, and subsidy are as per the current government resolution.
benefits_unverified_note: Whether Magel Tyala Shettale or a successor water-conservation service is open, and the current subsidy, must be confirmed on MahaDBT or agri.maharashtra.gov.in. This app does not treat the scheme as always open.

eligibility.notes: Typically individual farmers in Maharashtra with suitable land. Exact area limits and previous-benefit restrictions are in the current GR.

required_documents.name: Aadhaar
required_documents.why: MahaDBT authentication.

required_documents.name: 7/12 extract and 8A
required_documents.why: Pond site must match land records.

required_documents.name: Bank passbook
required_documents.why: DBT of assistance.

required_documents.name: Photographs / site photos if demanded
required_documents.why: Sometimes required after geo-tagging.

application_method: MahaDBT Agriculture services when the farm-pond service is listed as open.

application_steps.title: Check if the farm-pond service is currently open
application_steps.detail: Search MahaDBT agriculture services. If it is not listed/open, you are not in an active window.

application_steps.title: Read the current GR on the department site
application_steps.detail: https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in and https://krishi.maharashtra.gov.in (department site URLs as published).

application_steps.title: Open MahaDBT
application_steps.detail: https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in

application_steps.title: Authenticate on MahaDBT
application_steps.detail: OTP only on the government portal.

application_steps.title: Select the farm pond / shettale service if listed
application_steps.detail: Service title may vary.

application_steps.title: Enter survey number and proposed size
application_steps.detail: Follow the GR dimensions.

application_steps.title: Upload 7/12 and other listed documents
application_steps.detail: Only on MahaDBT.

application_steps.title: Submit for taluka/district approval
application_steps.detail: Field inspection is usual.

application_steps.title: Save application ID
application_steps.detail: Keep acknowledgement.

application_steps.title: Work and geo-tagging
application_steps.detail: Payment follows approved work and inspection, not this app.

deadline_note: Open only when the state lists the service. Treat as possibly closed until you see it on MahaDBT.
source_notes: Portal URLs verified. Current-year subsidy figures and whether the named service is open were not confirmed from a live GR in this dataset.

official_name: Farm Mechanisation / Agricultural Implements Subsidy (Maharashtra, via MahaDBT)
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra (often SMAM / state top-up)
benefits_summary: Subsidy on notified farm machinery and implements when the corresponding MahaDBT service is open. Eligible machines, farmer categories, and subsidy percentages are in the current guidelines.
benefits_unverified_note: Do not assume tractor/implement subsidy is open year-round or that a specific percentage applies to you.

eligibility.notes: Usually individual farmers, FPOs, or custom hiring centres as notified. Small/marginal and SC/ST categories may have different rates when the guideline says so.

required_documents.name: Aadhaar
required_documents.why: MahaDBT KYC.

required_documents.name: 7/12 extract
required_documents.why: Farmer landholding category.

required_documents.name: Caste certificate
required_documents.why: Only if applying under a reserved / higher-subsidy category.

required_documents.name: Quotation from empaneled vendor
required_documents.why: Many mechanisation services require empaneled dealers.

required_documents.name: Bank account
required_documents.why: DBT of subsidy.

application_method: MahaDBT agriculture mechanisation services when open.

application_steps.title: See the current implement list
application_steps.detail: Only notified implements are eligible.

application_steps.title: Check farmer category documents
application_steps.detail: SC/ST/small-marginal extra documents only if you claim that category.

application_steps.title: Open MahaDBT
application_steps.detail: https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in

application_steps.title: Register on MahaDBT
application_steps.detail: OTP stays on the government site.

application_steps.title: Open the mechanisation service if listed
application_steps.detail: If not listed, the window is closed.

application_steps.title: Select implement and vendor as instructed
application_steps.detail: Do not pay unofficial agents.

application_steps.title: Upload 7/12 and category proofs
application_steps.detail: On MahaDBT only.

application_steps.title: Submit before the service closing date
application_steps.detail: Portal shows the closing date.

application_steps.title: Save application ID
application_steps.detail: Required for dealer and department follow-up.

application_steps.title: Purchase only after approval if the guideline says so
application_steps.detail: Premature purchase can make you ineligible. Read that year's rule.

deadline_note: Shown on the specific MahaDBT service when it is open.
source_notes: Delivery channel verified (MahaDBT). Machine-wise subsidy table is not copied here because it changes.

department: Government of India (National Government Services Portal / myScheme)
benefits_summary: National directory to discover central and state schemes. It is not itself a benefit scheme. Use it to find official scheme pages.
benefits_unverified_note: Search results on myScheme must still be opened on the scheme's own official site before applying.

eligibility.notes: Any citizen can search. Eligibility is scheme-specific.

application_method: Browse https://www.myscheme.gov.in then follow the official apply link of the chosen scheme.

application_steps.title: Use myScheme only as a directory
application_steps.detail: It does not replace PM-KISAN, PMFBY, or MahaDBT applications.

application_steps.title: Search agriculture / farmer filters
application_steps.detail: Apply filters for your state.

application_steps.title: Open https://www.myscheme.gov.in
application_steps.detail: Official Government of India directory.

application_steps.title: No password should be entered in AI-KrushiMitra
application_steps.detail: If myScheme asks you to sign in, do it there.

application_steps.title: Open the scheme detail on myScheme
application_steps.detail: Then click through to the implementing department URL.

application_steps.title: Read eligibility on the implementing site
application_steps.detail: Prefer the department PDF/GR.

application_steps.title: Apply only on the implementing portal
application_steps.detail: PM-KISAN, PMFBY, MahaDBT, banks, etc.

application_steps.title: Submit on that official portal
application_steps.detail: Not in this app.
